title: Perplexity releases its Comet browser app for iOS and iPadOS with a built-in AI assistant, four months after launching on Android (Laurent Giret/Thurrott)
summary: Laurent Giret / Thurrott: Perplexity releases its Comet browser app for iOS and iPadOS with a built-in AI assistant, four months after launching on Android — Perplexity's Comet AI browser is coming to iOS and iPadOS today, four months after its previous launch on Android. The mobile browser comes with a built-in AI assistant …
